Rural lodging for groups in the main house (suite + bedroom + habitable mezzanine) and in an annex of two suites with double rooms, accommodating groups of up to 24 people. Camping area.

rancho-sabor-da-roca.descricao: Lets visitors experience the daily routine of the countryside and the farmer: handle vegetables straight from the garden; plant seedlings of various plants and vegetables; harvest your own fresh food and buy some products made on site, such as jams and craft beers. The place has an open-concept kitchen where a homestyle lunch is served, prepared on a wood-fired stove with ingredients grown on the farm. Arugula, spinach and broccoli. The jams are made with fruit from the farm; our beers are not yet sold off the premises and can be enjoyed on the farm. They are usually made with our own products, our own hops, and we make witbiers with arugula, orange, Sicilian lemon and lemongrass.

sitio-baroli.descricao: Stay, meals and a tour of the organic egg production areas.

sitio-caminho-da-luz.descricao: Organic fruit, root vegetables and leafy greens. Visit to the organic production. Gourmet space with barbecue, oven and wood-fired stove; trails, a small waterfall; a self-sufficient house, fully furnished, with two bedrooms, one double and one with three single beds.

sitio-do-ser.descricao: Lodging; breakfast; restaurant; guided trails; fishing lake; indigenous decor; not recommended for children; ideal for groups; reference center for aquaculture and hydroponics. Offers a sauna; football/volleyball field; swimming pool and wifi in the common areas. Spaces for workshops and events: rustic meeting room, a relaxed and simple setting, with capacity for up to 40 people. Equipment: TV, video, slide projector, outdoor amphitheater with capacity for 80 people. Ideal for immersive experiences, role-play and theatrical performances

sitio-gallo-da-serra.descricao: Organic production unit affiliated with the AAT - Agroecological Association of Teresópolis. Specializing in organic seedlings and fertilizers. Visit and hands-on experience in the production of seedlings, organic fertilizers and alternative organic inputs for planting. Visit and hands-on experience in the planting of organic products.

sitio-voze.descricao: Exhibition and workshop on making folk toys; giant puppet workshop. They offer space for small events and guided visits for tourist and school groups, with sales of local products and an exhibition of folk toys. Small vegetable garden. A place that safeguards the forest, wild animals, toys and games, and traditional popular cultures. They work to revive family values, free time, togetherness and good practices linked to rural life.

sobrado-jose-francisco-lippi.descricao: The townhouse (sobrado) houses and presents part of the history of Teresópolis: the life story of the Italian immigrant José Francisco Lippi and the beginnings of the village of Venda Nova. Besides documents, photographs, furniture and rooms from the late 19th century, the site includes gardens for strolling among flowers, fruit trees and birds. It covers 5,000 square meters prepared with nooks, corners and charms to welcome visitors and touch the hearts of children. School visits, group visits and research visits by appointment. Jabuticaba jam and liqueur, among other fruits and sweets.
sobrado-jose-francisco-lippi.funcionamento: Saturday, Sunday and holidays, 1:30 pm–5:30 pm

sitio-mariri.descricao: Organic production unit affiliated with the AAT - Agroecological Association of Teresópolis. Production of organic vegetables, fruit trees, legumes and herbs. Hands-on planting and harvesting experience

sitio-chitaca-muxima.descricao: Visits to the production of organic jams and preserves; organic liqueurs.

hipica-e-pousada-pelajo.descricao: Horseback rides, pre-booked riding lessons and spa services. Swimming pool, sauna, living room, games room, video room and gym. Inn (pousada).

hotel-fazenda-boa-vida.descricao: Farm hotel with several ecological trails, the largest lake in the region, and adventure activities integrated into nature such as treetop rope courses, a 500 m zip line and a climbing wall. Boa Vida has various animals such as chickens, ducks, ponies, a cow and more.

hotel-fazenda-do-holandes.descricao: The farm hotel offers breakfast, lunch and dinner, with drinks charged separately. It has a team of children's entertainers, live music at night and, on Sunday mornings, a circus troupe led by Fiapo the clown and his friends. Dry sauna, games room and restaurant with panoramic view, a chapel for religious purposes, swimming pool, football field, volleyball court, zip line, horseback rides, massage therapy and barbecue.

hotel-fazenda-jecava.descricao: The farm hotel covers an area of more than 7,500,000 m², with 15 ponds and an area of virgin forest with waterfalls and cascades where local wildlife can be found, as well as cattle breeding, Mangalarga Marchador and pampa horses, and small farm animals. It has 4 swimming pools, 3 courts, a games room, a convention room, a TV room, a playground, horseback riding, pedal boats, a zip line and treetop ropes courses.

hotel-fazenda-sao-moritz.descricao: The property offers a restaurant, piano bar, two outdoor swimming pools (one with a water slide), a gym, tennis courts and a running track, as well as saunas and a covered outdoor hot tub. Other activities include horseback rides and mini golf. Rowing boats are available, and guests are invited to interact with the animals on the farm. A wide range of leisure options.

hotel-fazenda-e-spa-gaura-mandir.descricao: The property offers a lounge for games and watching DVDs, a natural pool, a waterfall, trails, ecological walks, horseback rides, performances by artistic groups and music, workshops, courses in Indian and lacto-vegetarian cooking, mantras, dance, a bio-sauna, a games room, yoga, lectures, thermal baths, a living room, an events room, a panoramic deck, a lacto-vegetarian restaurant and a Natural Therapies Center.

hotel-fazenda-rio-dos-frades.descricao: The farm hotel stands on a 960,000 m² property, of which 600,000 m² is preserved Atlantic Forest, crossed by a trail that ends at a viewpoint with a 360° panoramic view. It has pedal boats, a zip line (subject to weight and age), a games room, a billiards room (for adults), a water slide, ecological fishing, heated swimming pools for adults and children, outdoor swimming pools for adults and children, dry and steam saunas, karaoke, a "bicholândia" (animal corner), a volleyball court, a football field, a bocce court, horses (for children), a tennis court (bring your own tennis equipment), a water slide and other leisure options.

hotel-rosa-dos-ventos.descricao: The hotel sits in the middle of a 100-hectare private park at an altitude of 1,250 m and has three restaurant options. Leisure options include 10 kilometers of internal trails for ecological walks, a riding ring, stables, horses, tennis, volleyball and futsal-style society football courts, two solar-heated swimming pools and an outdoor hydromassage jacuzzi, boats and kayaks, and sport fishing in a mountain lake fed by springs and unpolluted rainwater.

churrascaria-linguica-do-padre.descricao: A traditional restaurant that has been open without interruption for more than 30 years, serving family recipes. There is a hydroponic vegetable garden for the restaurant, open to visitors. Sale of craft cachaça, beer, the house's smoked sausage, sweets, honey, pepper and heart of palm.

restaurante-cremerie.descricao: A restaurant with a French touch, with recipes that use goat cheese in their compositions. The space has a mini playground and free visits to the animals - goats and chickens. Visit to the cheese dairy (production process and tasting) by appointment, and a chapel open to visitors. Craft beer production, served only on site.
restaurante-cremerie.funcionamento: Thursday, 12 pm–5 pm; Friday and Saturday, 10 am–10 pm; Sunday, 10 am–6 pm

la-biroska-romana-di-sandro.descricao: Italian cuisine and an atmosphere reminiscent of a true Italian cantina. Ideal for all ages and all kinds of groups and families.
la-biroska-romana-di-sandro.funcionamento: Thursday, 11:30 am–3 pm; Friday, 11:30 am–4 pm and 7 pm–10 pm; Saturday, 11:30 am–4 pm and 7 pm–10 pm; Sunday, 11:30 am–4:30 pm

marli-lili.descricao: Frozen pasta and savory dishes: quiche, empadão (savory pie) and pancakes, broths and sweets. Delivery only.
marli-lili.funcionamento: Wednesday, Thursday and Friday, 9 am–6:30 pm; Saturday, 9 am–2 pm

mini-max.descricao: Snack bar, bakery and confectionery. Gourmet grocery.

recanto-da-costela.descricao: Homestyle Minas Gerais cooking. Signature dish: ribs.

restaurante-cantina-verde.descricao: Restaurant serving homestyle Minas Gerais food. It usually displays artistic pieces at the entrance.

restaurante-flor-do-valle.descricao: Homestyle Minas Gerais cooking. On weekends, shared platters and broths.

restaurante-imbuhy.descricao: A variety of starters, pastas and meats in a space with rustic decor and an elegant atmosphere, with an emphasis on wines.

adelwil-arte-em-moveis.descricao: Shop selling antique, rustic and restored furniture and antiques such as chandeliers, paintings, rarities, works of art and more.

cantinho-valeria-fernandes.descricao: A slow food concept, voted one of the 7 gastronomic wonders of the State of Rio de Janeiro. Its main products are sweets, craft jams and savory snacks, all 100% natural and organic.

koisas-de-minas-moveis-e-decoracao.descricao: Sale of furniture in general, mattresses, decorative items and household utensils.

malte-lupulado.descricao: Sale of brewing supplies and craft beer brewing classes.

open-market-bazar.descricao: Bazaar with decorative objects, furniture, antiques and crafts

shopping-baluarte.descricao: A commercial center offering rental of shops, office rooms, kiosks and a space for a gym. It includes shops, a café, a grocery store, a gym, crafts, balaio, real estate and sabor da roça.

torarte-madeiras.descricao: Wooden furniture workshop; gallery under development with a traditional restaurant

vem-da-serra-artesaos-da-estrada.descricao: Studio for furniture and sustainable crafts. Offers handicrafts and décor by 13 local artisans, with original, sustainable pieces that reflect the local cultural identity.

casa-rosa-e-verde.descricao: Accommodation with breakfast and/or full board; bamboo management and treatment courses; day-use of the leisure area with swimming pool, football field and barbecue at the Holiday club. Homemade preserves; organic vegetable garden.

sitio-boa-ventura.descricao: Breakfast; lunch; farm visits; pick-your-own. Family farming and organic production.

sitio-demedeiros.descricao: Organic production unit affiliated with the AAT - Associação Agroecológica de Teresópolis. Organic crop production. Pick-your-own, forest walks, mini courses, meals. Visits by appointment, with or without a guide.

sitio-do-bicho-solto.descricao: Organic production unit affiliated with the AAT - Associação Agroecológica de Teresópolis. Organic vegetables and honey. Courses, internships and agroecological immersion experiences.

sitio-paraiso.descricao: Organic production unit affiliated with the AAT - Associação Agroecológica de Teresópolis. Organic production of leafy greens, vegetables and grains. Fishing, visits to the organic production area.

sitio-pe-de-serra.descricao: Free-range eggs and organic farming. Organic vegetable garden and animal husbandry. Lake with pedal boats; zip line; trails; breakfast; lunch; organic vegetable garden; animals and birds.

sitio-saira-azul-organicos.descricao: Organic production unit affiliated with the AAT - Associação Agroecológica de Teresópolis. Ecological trails and walks, guided insight into planting and harvesting, fishing, meals, overnight stays, visits to the municipal mountain park, organic produce for sale, birdwatching, talks on environmental education and agroforestry, animal husbandry.

sitio-terra-de-guaxo.descricao: Organic production unit affiliated with the AAT - Associação Agroecológica de Teresópolis. Diversified crop production, mainly bananas, sugarcane, cassava, corn, turmeric and okra. Beekeeping. Processing of farm produce into breads, cakes and tapioca dough. Guided tour of the fields and the processing area, organic farm lunch, activities for groups of children, agroecology class with hands-on activity suited to all audiences, discovery of PANCs (unconventional edible plants).

haras-sonho-verde.descricao: Walks and trails; visits to the stables of purebred horses; organic farming, notably vegetables, herbs and leafy greens.

rancho-cria-da-terra.descricao: Organic production unit affiliated with the AAT - Associação Agroecológica de Teresópolis. Organic chicken eggs, leafy greens, vegetables, fruit trees and honey. Private swimming lake, lodging for 80 people, grass football and volleyball pitch, walks and visits to the production area.

associacao-de-produtores-rurais-da-micro.descricao: Organization of the rural producers of Lúcios, training for rural producers, courses leading them toward agroecology, technical assistance, community kitchen; seed bank; workshop on breads and sweets made with farm produce. Creation of a network of women producers.

feira-organica-e-agroecologica-de-tereso.descricao: Organic food straight from the producers. Vegetables, leafy greens, fruit, eggs, honey, green juice, sugarcane juice, breads and cakes, homemade sweets, organic seedlings and fertilizers. Live music and lunch every Saturday, playground for children, cultural events, local crafts, home delivery of produce baskets. Free parking for customers.

sitio-sabor-da-montanha-organicos.descricao: Organic production unit affiliated with the AAT - Associação Agroecológica de Teresópolis. Organic leafy greens, fruit, vegetables and grains, jams, preserves and sweets. Visits, breakfast, lunch or afternoon snack, harvesting of produce.

paraiso-das-flores.descricao: Pick-your-own. Nursery with 3 greenhouses. Products available: orchids, bromeliads, groundcovers, fruit trees, decorative stones, clay, polyethylene and cement pots, soils, palm trees, bougainvillea, rose seedlings, living fences, arrangements, and much more.

atlantica-turismo.descricao: Tour operator. Priority segment: ecotourism. Specialized in beer tours. Sells domestic and international packages, operates transfers, sells European train tickets.

rota-certa-ecoturismo.descricao: Tour operator specializing in ecotourism, family leisure, rural tourism, rappelling, trekking, trekking, horseback riding and rural experiences. Adventure tourism.

ecoplay-tour.descricao: Travel agency. Priority segment: ecotourism. Specialized in rural, gastronomic and educational tourism. Ecoplay offers visitors experiences that value the local community and raise environmental awareness. Has six structured, priced itineraries.

notur-travel.descricao: Receptive (inbound) agency. Priority segment: cultural (civic, ethnic, religious, mystic and esoteric). Specialized in gastronomic, educational and cultural (historical heritage) tourism. Home-office agency.

retour.descricao: Travel agency. Priority segment: inbound and outbound tourism, cultural, rural, educational, religious, gastronomic and beer tourism, and ecotourism. RÉTOUR was the first to offer inbound and rural tourism in Teresópolis, with more than 15 years in the market.

fazenda-sete-voltas.descricao: Fish-and-pay fishing, restaurant, horseback riding, animal visits, barbecue grill rental and a space with swimming pool, sauna and football field.

fazendinha-rio.descricao: Fazendinha Rio is one of the best attractions in Vargem Grande if you plan to visit the neighborhood with children. It is considered an educational rural park, where little ones can get in touch with farm animals, explore the vegetable garden and orchard, go horseback riding and even milk the cows.
fazendinha-rio.funcionamento: 10 am–5 pm – Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays

museu-quilombo-cafunda-astrogilda.descricao: There you can visit the Quilombo Museum and also take the chance to try some of the restaurants within the community. Bar da Nilza and Bar e Restaurante Tá na Boa are the best known in the area.

arca-do-noah-parque-de-educacao-ambienta.descricao:
This is your zoo in Guaratiba, in the West Zone of Rio de Janeiro. We have an interactive petting-farm area where visitors can feed animals such as ponies, llamas, goats, buffalo and many others, using food provided by the park. The Immersion Aviary is the highlight of the interaction, with nearly a hundred birds that eat from your hands! (a portion of seed is provided by the park)

Visits are self-guided, and our staff are strategically placed throughout the park to give you the best possible experience during your visit.
arca-do-noah-parque-de-educacao-ambienta.funcionamento: 9 am–4 pm – Monday to Friday (school visits) | 9 am–4 pm – Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays (open to all)

caminhada-de-santa-cruz.descricao:
Route 1 - Fazenda Real de Santa Cruz: Before Petrópolis, the Imperial Family spent its holidays in Santa Cruz.
Sites visited: Igreja de Santa Bárbara, Jesuit School, Fazenda Real headquarters, single-family slave quarters and slavery in Santa Cruz, Casa do Conde dos Arcos, the old neighborhood center, the former Slave Hospital, Casa de Augusta Candiani, the Third Mixed School of Brazil, the Fazenda gateway and the Monument to the Expeditionary Soldiers.

Route 2 - The Santa Cruz that feeds the whole National Capital, from Crown Jewel to provider of the Capital: discover how far ahead Santa Cruz once was in the modernization of the country.
Sites visited: Largo do Bodegão and its trade, electricity arrived here first, Baron and Princess: two schools of noble origin, Mirante da Boa Vista, the trains that connected Santa Cruz to the World, the row of houses: the Workers' Village of the Imperial Slaughterhouse, ruins of the Slaughterhouse, 450 Years Mural, Palacete Princesa Isabel, which never belonged to Isabel! and the Glaziou Gardens, or what is left of them.

Route 3 - Residences, Landmarks and World References: discover how Santa Cruz attracted the attention of important figures and how much this influenced our architecture.
Sites visited: old villas, manor houses and mansions: their stories through architecture, 450 Years Mural, Palacete Horácio Lemos, Monument to Santos Dumont, the neighborhood's old cinemas, Espaço Cultural NR (except Sundays), Wallace Fountain, Júlio Cesário de Mello Residence, Imperial Farm Landmark, Fazenda Real gateway and Landmark XI
caminhada-de-santa-cruz.funcionamento: Advance booking with a registered guide is required

fogao-da-roca.descricao:
Rural Flavor at the Table: all-you-can-eat buffet of country food cooked on a wood-fired stove, just like typical farm cooking!
Single price including barbecue and dessert.
At the farm you will find: horseback riding, mini petting farm, live music on Saturdays and public holidays, a little waterfall of natural spring water for children, catch-and-release fishing in our lake full of fish, bouncy castle for children, surrounding nature, trees, plants and a variety of flowers.
Free admission, parking and access to the animals.
Wheelchair accessible.
fogao-da-roca.funcionamento: 7 am–6 pm – Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays | 7 am–12 pm – Breakfast | 11 am–4 pm – Lunch

sertao-do-vale-mambucaba.descricao: Get to know the places where agricultural produce is processed at an association, with a visit to the fields where the produce comes from. Experience the reality of a rural producer, always guided by a producer.

sertao-de-mambucaba.descricao: Connection with nature and visits to historical sites of the region, which was the stage for the passage of coffee from the Paraíba Valley during Brazil's imperial period, and also for the Banana cycle in the 20th century. Departure from Sítio São João and walk to Cachoeira das Três Quedas, for swimming and contemplation.

aldeia-sapukai.descricao: The Guarani preserve their ancestral traditions, such as dances and songs, and most are bilingual, since besides Tupi Guarani they also speak Portuguese. The residents lead a simple life, growing food such as cassava, banana and palm heart for their own sustenance, along with medicinal plants. Their colorful basketry, necklaces, bracelets and wooden crafts are much appreciated by tourists. When visiting the village you will be introduced to Guarani culture through activities such as cultural singing, body painting, conversation circles, traditional food, a guided tour and performances. For adventure lovers, there are also activities such as a guided trail to the beautiful Cachoeira da Aldeia, blowgun target shooting and archery.

sertao-de-mambucaba-2.descricao: Birdwatching tour amid the Atlantic Forest and its scenic beauty.

aie-eletuloju.descricao: Aiê Eletuloju: a door to the sacred in the Quilombo Santa Rita do Bracuí. Agroecosystem, immersive experiences, trails, talks, workshops, farm products, cultural activities, teaching on ethnobotany and ethnoecology, sustainable management practices. An agroecological hub focused on education, working around central axes such as Quilombo, Candomblé and the broad spectrum of permaculture.

bee-point-meliponario-saco-do-ceu.descricao: A place to get to know native stingless bees, taste honey produced in the Atlantic Forest and learn about the importance of pollinators for forest health. Guided tour led by a professional with a university degree in beekeeping and meliponiculture (stingless beekeeping), opening of hives, tasting of honeys and orchard fruit. A meliponary licensed by the environmental authorities and open to visitors, ready to welcome tourists and offer a unique experience tasting the honeys of the native bees of the Costa Verde.

sitio-sao-joao.descricao: Breakfast, lunch, camping. Starting at 8:30 am with a delicious breakfast until 10 am, followed by a walk to the wire bridge and waterfall at Sítio São João, returning at 12 pm for lunch!

hotel-fazenda-vira-country.descricao: Visit to the only distillery in the city - Cachaça Desinibida de Angra, with tasting, swimming pools, fish-and-pay fishing, a walk to a beautiful waterfall and a kids' area. The distillery visit is a true immersion in cachaça production. The distillery is located inside Hotel Fazenda Vira Country, which offers fish-and-pay fishing, swimming pools, a kids' area and a waterfall.

alho-poro-restaurante.descricao: Contemporary cuisine based on seafood, with beef and pork options as well as a variety of risottos. Mountain atmosphere, family-friendly setting and rustic décor, where guests can enjoy waterfalls and a natural pool with crystal-clear water, taking in nature and birdsong.

turismo-de-base-comunitaria-do-quilombo-.descricao: The Quilombo Santa Rita do Bracuí has a beautiful history of struggle and tradition. Community-Based Tourism was the means the quilombolas used to share their history and earn an income. Options for tourists: spend a lovely day in the community, quilombola breakfast, trail, casual lodging, traditional meals, workshops, storytelling and other attractions. All activities are run by the quilombolas.

republica-educacao-solidaria.descricao: Located across from the Janete Dias de Aguiar Tourist Terminal, the gateway to Vila do Abraão, the capital of Ilha Grande, the Republica Educação Solidária site houses a group of symbolic buildings meant to connect visitors with the community and help them recognize themselves in the space, giving new meaning to the visitor's sense of belonging and territoriality. Our distinguishing feature is the Short Marketing Circuit, in which we offer the chance to meet the residents and buy directly from the producer, getting to know their space and helping to sell their versatile products and services. Visit duration: To uphold the principles of República Educação Solidária, there is no set average visit time, since the circuit can last from a few hours to a lifetime.

nativa-da-ilha-tours-concierge.descricao: Nativa da Ilha is a micro-enterprise created to be a tool for social impact in the Ilha Grande Bay region. Its mission is to support not only traditional communities, but also to help build an awareness of respect for and appreciation of popular culture, offering products and services that contribute to a new perspective and awareness that helps prevent traditional identities from being diluted. Our community-based tourism itineraries aim to promote fairer and more inclusive tourism, as they put the local population in the leading role in responding to the demands of local ecosystems and help generate income and autonomy for these rural populations.

cooperativa-mista-sul-fluminense.descricao: Visits to the rural properties of cooperative members and a look at the daily routine of family farmers, meals, farm breakfast, lake fishing, river swimming, and more.

restaurante-70-da-roca.descricao: Mini petting farm with plenty of attractions. Leisure area, games room and animals for the children. Minas Gerais-style restaurant. A space to rest after lunch, leisure area, walks around the farm.

sitio-bumerangue.descricao: Mini farm, horseback riding, mini zoo, lakes with fish, swimming pools, zip line, meals.

haras-mazomba.descricao: Horseback riding, equine therapy, Mangalarga Marchador gait trials, mini petting farm, pick-your-own, café with coffee (under construction).

emporio-da-barreira.descricao: Restaurant amid nature with a historic trail and waterfall. Contact with nature in a rustic, welcoming setting with family-farm products.

estacao-de-permacultura-dumatutu.descricao: A space devoted to sustainable practices: ecological trails, agroecological food production, sustainable management of the Juçara palm, and permaculture courses.

agroindustria.descricao: The Mangaratiba Agroindustry processes local produce, making dried bananas, banana flour and a variety of sweets according to the local harvest. The building houses the Municipal Farmers' Association, which is responsible for processing and selling the products. The site also has historical and cultural importance, as the building stands very close to the Ruins of Saco de Cima.

fazenda-da-lapa.descricao: A historic farm from the coffee era of the former town of São João Marcos, also known as São João do Príncipe. It is located in the Serra do Piloto, on the Imperial Road of São João Marcos, the first carriage road in Brazil. The farm is open for visits and offers lodging, a restaurant and a thrift shop. It has horses, a chicken coop and dairy cattle, and produces artisanal cheese, organic bananas and a vegetable garden. The manor house is well preserved and has a period coffee-drying yard. There are trails through the Atlantic Forest, springs and a natural pool.

art-cafe.descricao: A café with a cozy atmosphere, much-praised sausage bread and cornmeal cake, handicrafts and country products.

circuito-imperial-da-serra-do-piloto.descricao: The tour includes a 4x4 ride, a historical guided tour of the sights along the route (with a Cadastur-accredited guide specialized in natural attractions), an ecological hike to the Ribeirão das Lajes Reservoir viewpoint and Ponte Bela, a snack kit, a waterfall swim, a wood-fired lunch (not included), and medical and hospital assistance insurance.

sitio-sao-goncalo.descricao: An artisanal distillery with organic cachaça production, free-range hens producing eggs, a frog farm open to visitors for a hands-on experience, and an apiary producing mead.

alambique-paratiana.descricao: An artisanal distillery with guided visits and a shop offering a wide variety of handmade products.

alambique-pedra-branca.descricao: An artisanal distillery with a great view of the mountains and a shop selling local products.

cachaca-coqueiro.descricao: The oldest artisanal distillery still operating in the municipality, since 1803, with a shop selling local products at its headquarters. Guided tour of the distillery grounds, explaining the production process and telling the story of the oldest cachaça still in production in the municipality.

cachaca-maria-izabel.descricao: The only distillery in the municipality founded and run by a woman, who personally supervises every stage of production and gives the cachaça its name. An experience with a conversation circle led by the owner, who explains the stages of the production process and even the history of cachaça in the municipality of Paraty.

engenho-corisco.descricao: One of the most traditional distilleries in Paraty, run by the same family for decades and keeping its traditions alive. You can take a tour explaining the cachaça-making process and taste all the flavors in the shop.

alambique-engenho-d-ouro.descricao: Guided tour telling the story of Engenho D'Ouro cachaça. The property has an old cassava flour house, a restaurant and a shop selling artisanal sweets, and the distillery sits next to the Tobogã waterfall.

paraty-tours.descricao: A very well-organized travel agency with more than 28 years of experience.

agencia-paraty-adventure.descricao: An accredited travel agency with 12 years of experience in Paraty.

akura-outdoor-experience.descricao: A travel agency focused on ecotourism, offering customized itineraries.

quilombo-campinho-da-independencia.descricao: The families living in the Quilombo keep alive traditions such as Jongo and Capoeira, as well as stories and knowledge that trace back to the African continent. The tourism practiced there is community-based, and one of the main attractions is a beautiful waterfall, along with trails, ruins from the era of slavery, conversation circles and traditional cuisine, which visitors enjoy in a space built next to residents' homes.

pousada-bromelias.descricao: Inn with spa and restaurant. Restaurant, leisure area with pool, game room, tennis court, sauna, reading lounge with hammocks, and a waterfall with a private natural pool within the inn's grounds. A wellness area houses the inn's spa, with massages, therapies, ofuro hot-tub baths and much more.

comunidade-tradicional-caicara-de-trinda.descricao: Community-based tourism celebrating the culture and identity of the traditional caiçara community of Trindade. Conversation circle with fishermen, a visit to the floating fish trap, a visit to the cassava flour house, puppet theater, a photo/video/documentary screening on the history of Trindade followed by a discussion, Folia de Reis, a crafts workshop, a net carving/sewing workshop, and more.

sitio-rancho-capitu.descricao: Activities include agroforestry work, birdwatching and visits to the waterfalls on the property.

fazenda-bananal.descricao: Fazenda Bananal is an unmissable destination for rural tourism lovers, with 187 hectares open to visitors. Its highlight is sustainability, present in every respect: environmental, historical-cultural and social. The visit to Fazenda Bananal is personalized, allowing visitors to create their own itinerary. The first recommended stop is the Historic Manor House, listed by IPHAN, with its original structure preserved. Today the space is used for temporary exhibitions that tell the history and traditions of Paraty. The second stop is a route presenting models and technologies that use the strength and intelligence of nature to create cleaner, more sustainable production systems. During the tour you can see the agroforest, the organic vegetable garden, the green septic system, the biodigester and other good practices in our relationship with nature. The final tip is a visit to the restaurant, which serves delicious dishes that vary with the seasonality of the ingredients and prioritize local produce. The farm's agroforest and garden supply the restaurant with more than 60 different products a year, grown without pesticides or chemical fertilizers. In short, Fazenda Bananal is an incredible place that combines development and sustainability, preserving historical and cultural heritage and promoting conscious tourism. If you want to learn more about sustainable practices, enjoy delicious organic meals and take a personalized tour, don't miss Fazenda Bananal!
fazenda-bananal.funcionamento: Monday to Sunday, 10 am–5 pm. The restaurant requires advance reservations and is open from 12 pm to 5 pm.

cachaca-tellura.descricao: Produced at Fazenda Abadia, which has grown sugarcane for more than 100 years. Visitors will find true Cachaça-Art, produced in copper stills since 2015. To guarantee quality, the care starts with planting the sugarcane and extends to the harvest, which is done by hand. Another notable point is the sanitation of the factory, done with steam to clean the pipes and stainless-steel containers, eliminating bacterial infection. The fermentation of the cane juice uses selected yeasts free of harmful bacteria. Distillation strictly follows a process of separating the head, heart and tail fractions, using only the heart in production, resulting in an internationally acclaimed cachaça. The cachaça then rests in barrels of noble woods, ensuring better aroma, color and flavor in the final product. It was awarded in Brussels in 2017, where it received recognition from the International Taste & Quality Institute, earning the “Superior Taste Award” certificate.

cachaca-barra-velha.descricao: Maker of the award-winning “Barra Velha” cachaças, Alambique do Leley is also where you will find excellent home-style food cooked on a wood-burning stove, handicrafts and a variety of regional sweets. Located on the Campos beach of Farol de São Thomé, specifically at Fazenda São Thomé, you will find the facilities for the artisanal production of these famous cachaças, which are recognized and certified by Brazil's Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock and Supply. Aging takes place in Pernod Ricard oak barrels, which, together with the perfectionism of the producer Leley, ensures success by adding quality and refinement to the products. The aged white cachaça won a Gold medal at Expocachaça in Belo Horizonte. For the third consecutive year, “Barra Velha” cachaça ranked among the best in Brazil, which also earned international recognition.

cavalhada-de-santo-amaro.descricao: The Cavalhada is the highlight of the largest traditional religious festival in the Norte Fluminense region, the “Festa de Santo Amaro”, celebrated on January 15 in honor of the patron saint of the Baixada Campista. The Cavalhada is a tradition dating back to the Middle Ages, in which 24 horsemen divided into two groups, identified by the colors red and blue, stage a mock battle between Moors and Christians, showing off their skills and devotion.

alambique-do-taizinho.descricao: Located in the district of Santa Maria, Cachaça Soberana, produced by Mr. Taizinho, comes in a great variety of flavors, including the hard-to-find Jambu cachaça.

cachoeira-do-bau.descricao: Daily responsibilities and tasks can raise our stress levels, and to forget these routine worries there is no better remedy than nature. Relaxing in a natural pool formed by a waterfall, surrounded only by trees and mountains, to the sound of birdsong: this is the experience of those who visit Cachoeira do Baú, in the countryside of Cardoso Moreira. This is the right place for anyone who wants to refresh the soul in the icy waters of a waterfall, thinking of nothing but that unique moment.

sitio-trapiche.descricao: With an authentic countryside feel, Sítio Trapiche offers visitors the perfect setting for a great family weekend. The property has two swimming pools, a covered barbecue area, table games, a bouncy castle and much more, all to help you relive the good moments of childhood. Those who get to know Sítio Trapiche experience unique moments that strengthen family bonds even further, with plenty of joy and fun.

atelie-nos-da-madeira.descricao: Unique handmade pieces representing the authentic art of Cardoso Moreira. The “Nós na Madeira” studio holds a large collection of cultural works by artists from the municipality of Cardoso Moreira, with pieces made from reforestation, reused and recycled wood, combining art and sustainability.

alambique-engenho-bau.descricao: Follow the artisanal cachaça production process, with sensory analysis and tasting.

fazenda-da-pedra.descricao: A historic place belonging to a traditional family, with countless stories and riches for tourists to be enchanted by and discover. In 1883 the farm belonged to the Baron of Azeredo Coutinho, and on June 24 of that year it received a visit from Emperor Pedro II for lunch. The emperor was traveling from São Fidélis to Campos to inaugurate the city's electric lighting that evening. In 1976, scenes from the first version of A escrava Isaura were filmed at Fazenda da Pedra.

bar-do-edgar.descricao: Close to the most beautiful waterfalls in the region, on the banks of the Colégio River, it offers contact with nature and a family-friendly atmosphere. It is also part of the cycling route.

casa-da-farinha-amparo.descricao: Visitors have the chance to see both the plantation and the production area of Casa de Farinha Amparo, a family-farming tradition. For 30 years they have produced a special cassava flour, considered the best in the region.

alambique-dos-reis.descricao: Made artisanally in copper stills, with natural fermentation and its own selected sugarcane field.

viticultura-fazenda-vale-do-tabuinha.descricao: The vineyard is already a family tradition and, besides producing delicious grapes that are sold around the region, welcomes visitors who can see the plantation. It is also a great option for students in the field to see the whole winegrowing process in practice. It also hosts June festivals, visits with tastings, and sales of its products. A family-friendly setting in direct contact with nature.

fabrica-dona-chica.descricao: The factory makes sweet cassava starch, sour cassava starch, tapioca starch, beiju and a cheese-bread mix. It also grows pink pepper and black pepper and manages eucalyptus.

dona-calu.descricao: A day-on-the-farm experience, with a variety of animals and tastings of artisanal products made on site.

boutique-do-artesanato.descricao: A variety of handicrafts made by local artisans.

barco-do-lael.descricao: Boat trip through the Gargaú Mangrove and along the Paraíba River coast. Service offered for more than 20 years.

fabrica-de-goiabada.descricao: Production of cascão guava paste in blocks and in straw-wrapped form. Everything is very artisanal.

rancho-do-peixe-pesque-e-pague.descricao: A very pleasant spot, with a leisure area for adults and children, a pool, and delicious home-style food.

cavalgada-dos-amigos.descricao: The Cavalgada dos Amigos is a cultural event in the form of a horseback ride, where riders of all ages, from children to seniors, who share a love of country life come together along the route. The event takes place every year in May and attracts visitors from several towns in the region.

sitio-vovo-berenice.descricao: The property has 2,500 hens and produces 200 dozen eggs a day. Besides this activity, there is a vegetable garden and a coconut grove, where visitors can pick what they want to take home straight from the plant. Fresh eggs, coconut water and freshly harvested vegetables are sold on site. Visitors are welcomed by the owner, who tells the family's story and how the farm that gave rise to the place began.

sitio-familia-toledo.descricao: This family-run rural property has a mandala garden of assorted vegetables, offering an immersive experience for visitors, who can also tour the orchard and, depending on the time of year, pick oranges, tangerines and watermelons. You can get to know species such as the annatto tree and even collect fresh eggs in the small backyard chicken coop. At the end of the tour, a simple but typical country-style snack awaits, with hot boiled sweet potato and cassava, cornmeal cake, jams and juices from seasonal fruit, and freshly brewed coffee. Not to mention the hospitality of the owner, Manoel Toledo, who welcomes everyone with a generous smile. The harvested products can be bought by visitors, as can the others also sold on site. The afternoon snack is part of the experience and is included in the entrance fee.

rancho-paiol.descricao: The ranch can accommodate 44 people, seated at tables for 8, 6 and 4, and operates for private events, with a set menu and by reservation.

cervejaria-fredbier.descricao: Hands-on experiences of the beer-brewing process, and tasting.

borgo-del-vino.descricao: Gastronomy. Tastings and wines. A wine cellar specializing in Brazilian wines, with labels tried and approved from hand-picked wineries.

solar-fazenda-do-cedro.descricao: Farm hotel, mini farm, recreation, cycle path, gastronomy, hiking trail and horseback riding.

agrovila-terra-de-guaxo.descricao: Interaction with agroecological crops and organic food produced on site.

casa-do-tapete.descricao: Weaving. Handcrafted work. Visitors can operate the machines and make their own rug.

fazenda-paraiso.descricao: Centuries-old farm, gastronomy, gin distillery, horseback riding, hiking trails, waterfall, music festivals, conventions and private events.

chacara-santana-ilha-do-borella.descricao: Restaurant specializing in fish, boat gatherings, kayaks and biking. Immersion in nature in the middle of the Paraíba River.
chacara-santana-ilha-do-borella.funcionamento: Thursday to Sunday and public holidays, from 11 am.

fazenda-da-bocaina.descricao: Native Atlantic Forest reserve, preserved by the farm's owners. Cattle raising, fish farming, bromeliad, anthurium and orchid greenhouses, horseback and carriage rides, walks on exclusive trails, swimming and fishing in the ponds, watching the sunset with a picnic, planting and harvesting some food, visiting the vegetable garden and orchard, and feeding the animals.

fazenda-cachoeira-pousada-colonial-valve.descricao: Available for rent for events, retreats, parties, weddings and baptisms. It has a church, a colonial house, a waterfall, a swimming pool, horses, milking in the corral, trails, pig feeding, an old plough, an ox cart, and more.
fazenda-cachoeira-pousada-colonial-valve.funcionamento: From Friday 6 pm to Sunday 6 pm.

fazenda-boa-esperanca.descricao: Day use on an 18th-century farm, with period furniture, ecological trails, a registered climbing rock, refreshing showers, river bathing, horses for hire, full board, jams for sale, souvenir postcards, pesticide-free fruit, vegetables, eggs and milk, and items from the era of slavery.

haras-da-ginga.descricao: Horseback riding and equestrian show. Champion Pampa Marchador horses.

hotel-fazenda-cheiro-do-mato.descricao: Accommodation, breakfast, lunch, swimming pool, fishing and horseback riding.

fazenda-monte-cafe.descricao: A two-hundred-year-old farm from the slavery era, inventoried by the Instituto Cidade Viva of Rio de Janeiro and the Federal University of Minas Gerais, where visitors will feel the atmosphere of a farm of the Coffee Barons. Now engaged in rural tourism, it offers visitors the Pampa horse carousel, meditation at Isabel Libertadora's Wishing Pond, the avenue of imperial palms and the crossing of the footbridge, cow milking, a bamboo grove tunnel, a river beach, swimming in the dam, a stone lookout, a nursery and orchard, paintings by José Maria Vilarongo, the ruins of a drying yard, an aqueduct and a stone mill.

ecoplay-tour-agencia-receptiva-e-operado.descricao: A route visiting historic farms and attractions of the region. We are an agency and tour operator specializing in selling rural experience itineraries in Rio de Janeiro state to the travel trade.

fazenda-sao-fulgencio-alambique-sao-fulg.descricao: Distillery visit; if booked in advance, you can watch cachaça being made. You can also taste the cachaça from the different barrels. Our cachaça is produced in a traditional still, but with infrastructure comparable to agro-industrial systems.

alambique-cachaca-itajoana.descricao: The distillery is open to visitors, and you can see the whole careful production process of Itajoana; for groups of 10 or more, a hearty lunch can be booked on site. Cachaça Itajoana, produced in the district of Bemposta, in the city of Três Rios, combines the warmth of the countryside with an extremely tasty cachaça. This premium spirit, launched in 2017, aims to offer cachaça lovers distinctive, high-quality blends. In 2020, Cachaça Itajoana won a gold medal at Expocachaça, in the Cachaça Blends category, with its black label (Balsam, Oak and Amburana blends).

duvivier-hotel-fazenda.descricao: The farm hotel offers experiences with animals and the chance to pick produce from its vegetable garden. It has a water-powered mill where corn is ground. In some of the hotel's rooms, guests can enjoy a private outdoor wood-heated hot tub, in an exceptionally refined and cosy setting. By appointment, activities such as the Track Day are available, thanks to a partnership between the hotel and the RMattheis team (Stock Car and Rally dos Sertões), which runs its off-road track here.

fazenda-da-paciencia.descricao: Fazenda da Paciência now offers a unique accommodation experience: to enjoy the property, guests must rent the whole farm, enjoying a unique and exclusive taste of country life. Gastronomy and the breeding of Arabian horses are the highlights of the place, which also has a small waterfall on the property for the exclusive use of visitors.

encontro-dos-tres-rios-pontal.descricao: The place is a true leisure complex with a distinctly rural character. It consists of an inn and a restaurant that share the name of the site: Pontal. It is a permanent preservation area of the Atlantic Forest, living in harmony with a variety of wild animals within the reserve, and also has the Cachaça Museum, hammock area, zip line, treetop adventure course and climbing. All this with an enchanting view of the meeting of the three rivers. The meeting of the three rivers (Piabanha, Paraibuna and Paraíba do Sul), the only triple delta in Latin America (a perfect triangle), takes place in a spacious spot for tourists who also enjoy extreme sports. Rafters run the rapids of the Paraibuna River on a course of about three hours that ends at the meeting of the rivers. The Paraibuna is considered one of the best rivers in Brazil for the sport, as it has a large volume of water and does not depend on rain for rafting, and its rapids are class 2 and 3, allowing the sport to be practised all year round.
encontro-dos-tres-rios-pontal.funcionamento: Accommodation, day use and meals by reservation and appointment.

pesqueiro-recanto-dos-emmerich.descricao: Snacks, swimming pool, pay-and-fish pond, fun and a family-friendly atmosphere.

pesque-e-pague-remanso-verde.funcionamento: Weekends and public holidays. 9 am–5 pm.

cachaca-eller.descricao: Discover how cachaça is made, from harvesting, milling, fermentation and distillation to ageing.

horto-do-tiao.descricao: A pleasant, green setting where ornamental and fruit plants are grown, and where flower arrangements and much more are sold.
horto-do-tiao.funcionamento: Monday to Saturday, 7:30 am–5 pm. Sunday, 8:30–11 am.

cachaca-do-odil.descricao: Experience tour of cachaça production, which has been going on for over 30 years. Visits by appointment. Access via dirt road.

cerveja-bendita-breja.descricao: Learn about the craft beer production process and get to know the raw materials.
cerveja-bendita-breja.funcionamento: Tuesday, 5–11 pm. Friday, 7 pm–11:45 pm, and Saturday, 5 pm–midnight.

espaco-neu.descricao: Day use. Venue with swimming pools, a fish pond, waterfall, saunas and barbecue areas.

sitio-das-goiabas-schott.descricao: Have you ever had the chance to see guava products being made by hand? No? Meet the Schott family and their homemade sweets, the guava plantation, the preparation of the fruit, the boiler and the product storage area. A small farm where the Schott family grows guavas and shows how the production process works. Access is via dirt road.

fazenda-caieira.descricao: Located 8 km from the centre of Bom Jardim, the farm is equipped to host a variety of events. An excellent option for relaxing, with facilities for get-togethers. A leisure area with a natural-water swimming pool, waterfall, football pitch and other activities.

camping-recanto-da-siriema.descricao: Camping Recanto da Siriema - A space dedicated to camping, with green area, lake and support facilities for those who want to enjoy this activity.

refugio-do-humaita.descricao: Located in the district of Barra Alegre, Refúgio do Humaitá is a place offering a variety of experiences, from visiting the ornamental bird breeding facility to taking courses related to agro-industry.

hotel-fazenda-minha-gloria.descricao: Set amid nature, in a cinematic landscape of 165,000 square metres, it offers direct contact with exotic and gentle animals. Accommodation in independent chalets, in a rustic style that blends with the rural atmosphere.

sitio-das-jaqueiras.descricao: Great for relaxing. The place is a simple, rustic but very cosy setting in the countryside. The leisure area has a swimming pool, a barbecue and a large lawn with swings and a treehouse for children.

sitio-aconchego.descricao: The property is surrounded by nature and also has an orchard with a variety of fruits such as mulberry, mango, guava, avocado, starfruit and banana. Room service plus breakfast. Use of the swimming pool and the other facilities on the grounds is included, as well as the barbecue and sauna.

casa-do-leite.descricao: A lovely spot in the bucolic district of Bom Jardim. It offers irresistible treats: sweets, breads, cheeses and artisanal yoghurts that delight visitors' palates.

cafe-monthal.descricao: A beautiful farm, known for its coffee, milk, cheese and bolinho de chuva (sweet fried dough balls), which periodically opens its doors for an experience tour in which, through guided visits, visitors learn about country culture and the stages of coffee processing. From harvest to roasting, with a bit of history, culminating in a mini tasting tour of the different ways of preparing the drink. A chance to experience mountain harvesting. Live it on site, from the plantation to the final roast, enjoying incredible nature.

vila-de-porto-marinho.descricao: Visit to the most significant sites for the production and processing of Anã de Porto Marinho rice; visits to the homes of family farmers; boat trip on the Paraíba do Sul River and ox-cart ride; on-site explanation of the history of the village and the municipality, as well as the community's cultural traditions; sale of typical sweets and crafts; tasting of local cuisine, whose main attractions are Anã de Porto Marinho rice, a potential geographical indication, and fish.

fazenda-santa-fe.descricao: Visit to the farm of Sister Zélia and Jerônimo, the couple declared Servants of God, the only married couple beatified and in the process of canonization. It is a historic site and a sanctuary.

porto-velho-do-cunha.descricao: Fishing-inspired gastronomy, land trails, boat trips, sport fishing and crafts.

sitio-santa-luz.descricao: Contact with the work of the country people, with herbal medicine, medicinal plants, nursery, planting, knowledge and hospitality.

fazenda-boa-vista.descricao: Contact with nature, gastronomy, tree planting, hiking trails and horseback riding.

laticinio-trevo.descricao: Cheese tasting and a visit to the countryside.

laticinios-relogio.descricao: Gastronomy, history and an experience at a historic dairy. The history of the Relógio brand takes us back to the end of the 19th century, precisely 13 April 1871, the day Joaquim Simões de Araújo was born in Espinho, near Viseu, Portugal. In the vigour of his twenties, he joined three Portuguese friends and set out on an adventure to Brazil, dreaming of making a life under better conditions. Always driven by an entrepreneurial spirit, in 1912 he bought Fazenda João Dias and built a dairy there. With the railway station very close to the dairy, Joaquim shipped all the milk and butter by train to the larger cities. So the time the train passed set the pace of production. It is said that, in the middle of his work, he would repeat in his thick Portuguese accent: "Olha o relógio! Olha o relógio!" ("Mind the clock! Mind the clock!"), warning the employees of the right time for the train's arrival. And so, in this atmosphere of work and poetry, the name Relógio was born for the products.

parque-natural-municipal-do-livramento.descricao: Fresh air, contact with wild animals, native trees, trails, seedling planting, local history, river bathing and camping.

fazenda-conceicao.descricao: Contact with nature, wild animals, gastronomy, bike trails, waterfall swimming and plenty of history.

s-a-mudas.descricao: Seedling planting and learning about plants.

tunel-que-chora.descricao: Horseback trail, caves and contact with nature.

cachaca-da-quinta.descricao: Cachaça tasting, history and contact with nature. Since 1923, Cachaça da Quinta has been produced at Fazenda da Quinta, in a valley near the Paraíba do Sul River, at an altitude of about two hundred and twenty metres. The property has soil, climate and microclimate ideal for growing sugarcane, for fermentation and for making the products. To this especially favourable terroir are added the rigorous quality standards in the making of Cachaça da Quinta. It is well worth visiting to see the whole production process. The property has soil and climate ideal for growing sugarcane, for fermentation and for making the products. It was the first Brazilian spirit to receive the Grand Gold Medal at the Concours Mondial de Bruxelles. In the National Ranking of the Cúpula da Cachaça (2022–2023 biennium), Cachaça da Quinta – Branca received the highest score among all competitors, in an unprecedented feat: a white cachaça surpassing the scores of cachaças from different woods, stored, aged, premium and extra premium.

fazenda-santo-antonio.descricao: Contact with nature, waterfall swimming, gastronomy, local history and land trails.

feira-livre.descricao: Gastronomy, culture, local literature, organic products, crafts, creative economy and family farming.

sitio-aldeia-branca.descricao: Contact with nature, gastronomy, and a chance to learn how rapadura (raw cane sugar) and molasses are made. Seedling planting, hiking trails, and swimming in the river.

cooperativa-de-laticinios-de-conceicao-d.descricao: The cooperative quickly stands out for the quality of its milk, cheese, requeijão (creamy spreadable cheese), and, above all, its butter.

apicultura-jose-fortes-abelha-sem-ferrao.descricao: Talks, tastings, and honey sales. Keeping stingless bees is called meliponiculture and is aimed mainly at honey production.

esculturas-do-vinycios.descricao: Visitors can discover Vinycios' artistic collection, which gives his works a Renaissance feel, with scale and life-size sculptures.

cachaca-artesanal-rio-do-meio.descricao: Cachaça Artesanal Rio do Meio began production in 2004. Rio do Meio cachaça, named after the Sítio where it is made, started out as a drink for personal consumption, for friends and fans of the spirit.

exposicao-agropecuaria-industrial-e-come.descricao: The Exposition is an annual event (second half of July) aimed at promoting agribusiness, industry, and commerce in Cordeiro and the surrounding region.

fazenda-penedo.descricao: Tour of the main house and of the cachaça and artisanal liqueur factory. Lunch, drinks, beers, appetizer platters, and à la carte meals. Sales of the farm's own cachaça and artisanal liqueurs, and a bar.
fazenda-penedo.funcionamento: Monday to Friday by appointment. Weekends, 10 am–4 pm.

capitao-bock-cervejaria-e-bar.descricao: Capitão Bock's bar brings together good food, a leisure area, and every style of craft beer in one place. A spacious, airy venue, ideal for spending quality time with family and friends.

cachaca-d-altim.descricao: Sítio São Sebastião has a cachaça distillery and a whole space in harmony with nature. We also have our venda do barranco, a self-service pick-and-pay shop where you can find local products and seedlings of plants and fruit trees.
cachaca-d-altim.funcionamento: Tuesday to Friday, 10 am–6 pm. Saturday, 8 am–6 pm. Sunday, 8 am–1 pm.

cachoeira-do-thadeu.descricao: Space rental, waterfall swimming, bar, volleyball court, soccer field, fishing, sauna. A place of peace, connection with nature, and tranquility.

casarao-de-macuco.descricao: The building itself is one of the few old mansions still standing in the town center. Inside, it tells part of the story of the railway that was part of the municipality's founding and of great importance to the whole region.
casarao-de-macuco.funcionamento: Thursday to Saturday, 6 pm–2 am. Sunday from 12 noon.

fazenda-nossa-senhora-dos-prazeres-do-ri.descricao: We open at 10 am for those who choose brunch, or from 12 noon for lunch, which can stretch into afternoon tea to the sound of an accordion.

fazenda-benfica.descricao: Tour of a century-old farm with its history, lunch cooked on a wood-fired stove, and sales of handicrafts and homemade sweets.

recanto-do-lago.descricao: Production of homemade products, home-cooked meals, and a rustic space for visitors.

fazenda-boa-vista-2.descricao: Mineral water springs and tours of them, a walk along the stone-paved yard and around the farm grounds.

cooperativa-regional-agropecuaria-de-mac.descricao: Production of dairy products, with tours and a café.

fazenda-maravilha.descricao: Walk around the farm and workshops on making artisanal guava paste (goiabada) and banana paste (bananada).

madalena-adventure.descricao: ATV tours along the rural circuit of Santa Maria Madalena. Along the Estrada do 17 route there is a stop at Fazenda Boa Fé for tasting artisanal cheeses, and a stop at the Auberge Valaissane hotel to learn about the agro-industries on the property.

emporio-santa-maria.descricao: Souvenirs and decorative items featuring local handicrafts in general.
emporio-santa-maria.funcionamento: Monday to Saturday, 9 am–6 pm. Sunday, 9 am–3 pm.

armazem-um.funcionamento: Monday to Saturday, 7:30 am–7 pm. Sunday, 7:30 am–4 pm.

auberge-valaisanne.descricao: Auberge Valaisanne is more than a farm hotel; it is a refuge for carefree days. It has lakes for fishing, hiking trails, rapids, and visits to the plantations.

artesanato-mineral.descricao: Souvenirs of Santa Maria Madalena made by the town's craftspeople.

deguste-turismo-agencia-de-turismo-recep.descricao: Ground-handling services for sightseeing tours in the region, for example a Rural Jeep Tour.
deguste-turismo-agencia-de-turismo-recep.funcionamento: From 8 am to 4 pm. Online service.

amapruris-associacao-de-moradores-amigos.descricao: Tastings and sales of artisanal products made by the Association of Rural Women Producers of Ribeirão Santíssimo.

fazenda-sao-geronimo.descricao: Homemade sweets, jellies, liqueurs, pickled peppers, caponatas, pickles, cachaças, cheese, handicrafts, and above all, typical country meals.

queijaria-fazenda-boa-fe.descricao: On the way to Fazenda Boa Fé you travel along an old railway line, with passages and cuts through the rock and a bucolic, lush landscape. At our farm, you will learn about sustainability techniques, visit the cheese dairy and the tilapia farm. You can also taste the products, such as fresh cheeses and yogurts.

fazenda-santa-cruz.descricao: This historic farm, part of a valuable stretch of the old Leopoldina railway line, delights visitors with its native forests, natural lookouts, and stunning landscapes. Built by English engineers in the 19th century, the three tunnels on the farm have great historical and cultural value. The property, founded around 1880, has an imposing main house, old coffee mills, a cornmeal mill, a sugarcane mill, and a small hydroelectric power plant. During the visit, guests can explore the chapel, the distillery, and the old stone-and-wood mill, as well as enjoy snacks, beers, and Santa Cruz cachaça, produced on site. The picturesque setting, with well-kept roads, offers visitors a unique experience in which they can feel the atmosphere of the colonial era, take beautiful photos, and enjoy the surrounding landscape.

fazenda-boa-vista-alambique-sinha-brasil.descricao: A 19th-century property home to a premium cachaça distillery, a museum, and an impressive collection of more than 800 cachaça labels. Try the award-winning SINHÁ BRASIL, a cachaça produced under strict quality control, from growing the sugarcane to bottling. Explore the production process on monthly tours, where you can taste the different labels and enjoy an authentic lunch prepared on the farm. A unique tourist experience that will delight all your senses.

trajano-sem-fronteira.descricao: ATV, off-road motorbike, and 4x4 tours. Trajano X Triunfo, Trajano X Sodrelândia and the Dam, Trajano X Sunset, Pedra da Torre trail, Carrapato trail, Pereirinha trail, Retiro trail.

toca-da-coruja.descricao: Vehicle rental and guided sightseeing tours. Rental of ATVs, off-road motorbikes, and buggies. Camping area and rooms, also offering meals (snacks).

fazenda-do-canteiro.descricao: Rural Tourism and Gastronomy. Tour of a century-old farm of colonial architecture that is fully operational. We offer experiences in beef and dairy cattle farming, and in planting and harvesting guavas, sugarcane, vegetables, eucalyptus, and more.

fazenda-olaria.descricao: Tour of the town's old collection and of the historic 19th-century coffee-producing farm. The farm belonged to the traditional Moraes family, whose most prominent figure was Raul Veiga, who became governor of the state of Rio de Janeiro in the first half of the 20th century.

agua-mineral-trajano-de-moraes.descricao: Natural spring water source. Visit one of the best mineral water springs in the state.

rancho-jsg.descricao: Horseback rides, sunset watching from a deck, with views of a paradise-like scenery of mountains and lush greenery.

buteco-jsg.descricao: Typical music, modas de viola (traditional country songs), bonfires, horseback ride events, and sertanejo shows.

rancho-do-severino.descricao: All-you-can-eat home-style food cooked on a wood-fired stove in a family-friendly setting with outstanding service. Contact with animals raised at the ranch, a reference in Itaboraí and neighboring towns.

parque-paleontologico-de-sao-jose.descricao: Museum with various types of fossils, historical pieces, and a replica of the giant sloth. Connection with nature: lagoon, trails, wildlife watching.

hotel-fazenda-encanto-da-serrinha.descricao: Animal milking, pony and horse rides, a lake for sport fishing, little train rides around the property and surroundings, and sales of cheeses and jams made on the property, as well as fruit picked on the farm, such as banana, papaya, mango, siriguela, acerola, and orange, and various types of vegetables.

horto-santa-clara.descricao: Tour of the production area, with sales of ornamental plant and fruit tree seedlings. On-site sales are also possible.

fabrica-de-bananada-rio-bonito.descricao: Rio Bonito is known for its wealth of banana plantations, and the Bananada Factory uses fruit from the region and from local farmers. Visitors can take part in and learn about the entire process, from raw material to packaging and eventual distribution, and can also taste the sweets made on site.

so-do-milho.descricao: The place offers corn-based products, unique in the region. The corn milkshake is the top seller, along with roasted corn, juices, sweets, and savory snacks made from corn.

restaurante-quartas-na-lenha.descricao: Rustic setting surrounded by nature, fruit trees, a rural atmosphere, and meals cooked on a wood-fired stove. A space dedicated to an exhibition of antiques.

ecopolo.descricao: Visitors will see how the decorative items are produced by the local craftswomen, with access to the looms, the fabrics, and the finished pieces. They can also enjoy a delicious breakfast or afternoon coffee in the Ecopolo garden, prepared by the team. For 20 years we have been making bags, accessories, and Home Line products using hand weaving, an ancient technique in which fabric results from interlacing threads through the warp (vertical threads on the loom) and the weft (horizontal threads). All the work is done by hand. New collection with exclusive pieces made from recycled material.

hotel-fazenda-colinas.descricao: Farm hotel with good accommodations and spacious rooms, pools for adults and children, multi-sport court, sauna, game room, bar, and restaurant. Contact with nature, bike rides, horseback rides, pedal boats.

hotel-fazenda-rio-bonito-ecolodge.descricao: A great option for those seeking tranquility in the midst of nature. Lake with tambaqui and pacu for sport fishing, pool, grass soccer field, volleyball court, table football, vegetable garden outdoors, trails, and close to hang gliding ramps.

pitanga-decor.descricao: Regional breakfast or afternoon coffee, with typical products from the countryside. The meal is served outdoors, amid a banana plantation.

fazenda-dos-cordeiros.descricao: Originally 500 ha of preserved and protected land and agricultural production. A working farm that offers eco-rural tourism on its grounds. It has a traditional main house and 5 apartments available for guests. Children are welcome. Activities include eco-walks, hands-on organic farming, tree planting, feeding the small animals, a visit to the orchid house, a swimming pool and sauna, a football field, volleyball, games and other fun.

hotel-fazenda-vcp.descricao: Family-friendly atmosphere, horseback rides, traditional country cooking, regional festivals, a swimming pool and the farm's vegetable garden.

tapinua-dos-reis.descricao: Rural lodging, alambique-distilled cachaça and ecotourism activities such as trekking, river swimming and the chance to go birdwatching.

horta-natural-silva-jardim.descricao: Organic farm where visitors can watch and learn about organic growing techniques and how dried bananas (banana passa) are made. They supply restaurants and organic produce boxes for families.

quitanda-natural.descricao: A commitment to living, natural food, respecting people, the environment, fair trade and good practices for healthy growing. All our food is naturally fertilized, with no chemical pesticides or agrochemicals.

hotel-fazenda-lagoa-azul.descricao: Farm hotel with horseback rides, a pay-to-fish pond, a swimming pool and trails surrounded by nature.

pousada-estrela-dalva-daldeia.descricao: The inn offers big-city comfort combined with rural tranquility. Swimming pool with swim-up bar, hot tub, steam sauna, games room, waterfalls, playground, pony rides for children, restaurant, convenience store and much more.

circuito-da-laranja.descricao: If you enjoy oranges and rural tourism, this is a must. Along the route, visitors can see an orange orchard, pick and taste the fruit, visit several farms and buy farm products and handicrafts, enjoying a pleasant day in the countryside. An established route running since 2010, seasonally (during the orange harvest), the Circuito da Laranja has already been visited by thousands of people, mainly from the metropolitan area of Rio de Janeiro. All groups are accompanied by a local guide, who shares information about the town's history and facts, as well as guiding visitors through the stops. The Circuit offers an unforgettable rural experience, creating a bond between visitors and the countryside, and leaving everyone wanting to return and relive it.

sitio-juvak.descricao: Contact with nature, trails and views of beautiful landscapes. A small farm set in the Serra do Barbosão.
sitio-juvak.funcionamento: During business hours, Tuesday to Sunday; no advance booking required.

festa-da-laranja.descricao: Over its last 15 editions, the event has featured shows, games and talks for rural producers, the orange queen pageant, a best orange producer contest, a handicraft exhibition and stalls with typical rural food, celebrating the town's rural culture and its residents. The Festa da Laranja has been part of the official events calendar of the municipality of Tanguá since 2002, under Law 352/02. It is a traditional event in the municipality, aimed at promoting and honoring its main agricultural product, the orange, thereby strengthening the town's rural culture and traditions.
festa-da-laranja.funcionamento: Held in the second half of July. Usually a 3-day festival (Friday, Saturday and Sunday).

recanto-da-vovo-ruth.descricao: Delicious breakfast or lunch served by advance booking. It is a house for up to 6 people, where visitors can enjoy all its facilities. At breakfast, sweets and jams made on the property from seasonal produce are served.
recanto-da-vovo-ruth.funcionamento: Breakfast from 8 am to 10 am and lunch from 11:30 am to 2:30 pm.

festa-do-aipim.descricao: The traditional Festa do Aipim, held every year on May 1st, has become a tourist and gastronomic attraction of the locality, with a variety of cassava-based products. During the festival, typical dishes made with cassava (aipim) are sold, such as bolinho (fritters), pizza, sola, biju, italiano, cassava with dried beef, tapioca, caldo verde, vaca atolada, cassava flour and sweet cassava cake. There are also assorted sweets, a variety of juices and a farmers' market.
festa-do-aipim.funcionamento: From 10 am to 10 pm (on the day of the festival)

instituto-sinal-do-vale.descricao: You can rent a house in nature for a private group or rent the meeting space for company gatherings. Every detail of the space was carefully designed in harmony with nature: it inspires connection, engagement, appreciation and joy. In terms of hospitality, Sinal do Vale also works in gastronomy, using the Regenerative Cuisine method of food preparation. We use local ingredients, prioritizing vegetables, roots and fruits grown in our organic gardens and agroforests.
instituto-sinal-do-vale.funcionamento: Only by appointment for closed groups.

rancho-linda-vista.descricao: Rancho Linda Vista is a rural fishing restaurant in Xerém, RJ. But it goes beyond a simple country restaurant. Here we serve a delicious breakfast and have a lake for pay-to-fish or sport fishing, a swimming pool and a playground for the little ones. There is also plenty of room for children to run and play. Our little farm is a delight, with a variety of animals for the children to meet. At the Rancho we also serve a delicious wood-fired lunch. Some of our dishes include tilapia steak, pork loin with collard greens and chicken with okra. And to finish the meal, you can enjoy a mouth-watering pudding baked in the wood-fired oven. After lunch, you can rest in one of the hammocks scattered around the Rancho while enjoying a coffee with a broa (cornmeal cake). Here you have everything you need to spend a delightful day and create fond memories with your children, grandchildren and friends.*

rancho-peniel.descricao: Pay-to-fish pond, events, leisure (swimming pool) and accommodation.

haras-soares.descricao: Vaquejada park. The venue has swimming pools, a restaurant and event space. In 2022 it held the first vaquejada sanctioned by the ABVAQ in the Southeast, bringing in vaqueiros (cowboys) from many places.

haras-do-pimp.descricao: Petting and feeding the animals, horseback riding, animal sales, photo opportunities.

meliponario-assis.descricao: Get to know Brazil's native bees, taste the honey, and take beautiful photos that will be a hit on your social media.

sitio-raio-de-luz.descricao: Organic vegetable growing, tilapia fish farming, fishing and river swimming (São Pedro River).

sitio-arena-nordeste.descricao: Leisure farm in a rural area, with a swimming pool and barbecue area, football field, fishing lake, lodging quarters, games room, day rentals for events and performances.

delicias-de-quintal.descricao: Sale of handmade products: cheese, cheese bread (pão de queijo), cheesecake, ricotta, cake, cookies and milk; organic products; sale of ornamental fish; and a hands-on experience of the production line of the handmade products.
delicias-de-quintal.funcionamento: Monday to Friday, 8 am–5 pm; weekends, 8 am–3 pm.

sitio-santa-barbara.descricao: Food; visit to the agroforest with a clay bath; PANC (unconventional edible plants) handling course; sale of agroecological products, research area, camping area, catering services.

haras-rrg-yarapuan.descricao: Pay-to-fish pond; horse riding course (book ahead); horseback rides; Delícias da Rosa restaurant; sale of handmade ceramics, homemade sweets and plants.

chacara-vale-dos-manacas-sitio-pedra-lis.descricao: The experience awaiting visitors: a colonial-style breakfast at Chácara Vale dos Manacás-Tinguá-NI, with bread baked on site and served warm to visitors. During the colonial breakfast, guests can enjoy all the facilities of the Chácara (two swimming pools, kayak, hammocks, outdoor shower and more). That is the colonial breakfast. As for the Pedra Lisa Route, right after the Rural Breakfast we set off on a walk to Sítio Pedra Lisa, where we enjoy the natural beauty of this incredible remnant of the Atlantic Forest. Afterwards, we return to the Chácara, where we serve lunch. At Sítio Pedra Lisa, visitors will enjoy a 2.7 km walk through the Tinguá Municipal and Alto Iguaçu State Environmental Protection Areas. Along the way they will have views of the Serra do Mar mountain range and across Guanabara Bay. Once on the property, they will be led along Atlantic Forest trails, where they can swim in 2 crystal-clear, cascading rivers or simply admire the waterfalls, the lake, the Tinguaíto rock cave and the countless species of Atlantic Forest fauna and flora. For camping lovers, the farm offers rustic Wild Camping with bathroom facilities, running water, gas stove and refrigerator.
chacara-vale-dos-manacas-sitio-pedra-lis.funcionamento: Day Use Friday to Sunday and holidays, 8 am–5 pm (at the chácara only on event days)

alambique-caminho-do-vulcao.descricao: Visit to the distillery, the fruit plantations and the sugarcane field, and access to the deck with a panoramic view of the Serra do Vulcão, with the Caminho do Vulcão restaurant.

sitio-raizes-da-terra-vivencia-rural.descricao: A short introduction to cassava (aipim) growing (soil preparation, planting, upkeep and care, harvesting, processing), followed by a field experience demonstrating part of the necessary processes. Harvesting and preparing the dishes, and tasting, which depending on the program includes lunch or afternoon tea.

sitio-sao-jorge.descricao: The farm showcases agricultural and livestock activities, with plantations of various fruits, vegetables and greens and the raising of various animals. Production of cheeses and fruit preserves from seasonal fruit. The site is also used for events by cooperatives, partnerships and municipal schools.
sitio-sao-jorge.funcionamento: Day Use Friday to Sunday and holidays, 8 am–5 pm (at the chácara only on event days)

feira-da-agricultura-familiar-na-ufrrj.descricao: Meet family farmers, organic producers and those transitioning to agroecology. Buy diverse, locally produced food.

fazendinha-agroecologica-km-47.descricao: The Fazendinha Agroecológica do km 47 is a benchmark in organic and agroecological production in Brazil. It is a partnership between the Colégio Técnico da Universidade Rural (CTUR), Embrapa Agrobiologia, Pesagro-Rio and the Universidade Federal Rural do Rio de Janeiro (UFRRJ). The Fazendinha is the anchor of a series of technology-transfer and extension projects that enable the exchange of knowledge on the adoption and adaptation of technologies, products, processes and services. Courses, field days, lectures, visits and technical, scientific and educational meetings are held here for a wide range of audiences. During visits, groups experience both theory and practice, learning about education through agroecology, contact with the soil, biogeochemical cycles, organic fertilization, substrate production, sowing, horticulture, crop care and harvesting.

universidade-federal-rural-do-rio-de-jan.descricao: The Universidade Federal Rural do Rio de Janeiro (UFRRJ), specifically the neocolonial-style architectural complex of the Seropédica campus, listed by the Instituto Estadual do Patrimônio Cultural (Inepac), began construction in 1939. The extensive and beautiful landscaped park, designed by landscape architect Reynaldo Dierberger, was laid out at the same time, adding to the neocolonial pavilions gardens, artificial lakes, tree masses of native species, groves of palms, shrub clusters, ground cover, slopes and lawn beds. The main UFRRJ campus also plays a very important role in leisure, with sightseeing, walking, cycling and picnics in the areas near the existing lakes, as well as along the paved roads that cut through part of the main campus.

alambique-barbinotto.descricao: A distillery and cachaça maker specializing in the artisanal production of liqueurs and gold, silver and blended cachaças, aged in stainless steel vats, oak barrels, Brazil nut wood and pink jequitibá wood. Its distinguishing features are pure, high-quality cachaça and, above all, alcoholic drinks flavored with jambu. It has a restaurant open for lunch on weekends. Free tasting of the cachaças and artisanal liqueurs produced on site, and sales of cachaças and liqueurs. At the restaurant, weekend lunches with regional food.
alambique-barbinotto.funcionamento: Monday to Sunday, 8:30 am–5 pm. Restaurant: Friday to Sunday, from noon.

espaco-soberano.descricao: A beautiful rural property that hosts events, most of them open to the public, in a relaxed setting with a pleasant atmosphere, animals and a kids' area.
espaco-soberano.funcionamento: From 10 am to 7 pm (flexible on event days)

restaurante-recanto-do-pontal-batistinha.descricao: Spacious setting in close contact with nature. Family-style service.

bar-e-restaurante-pega-leve.descricao: A setting on the banks of the Paraíba do Sul River. Family boat rides. A spacious area with free-range chicken of unmatched flavor, plus appetizers.

toca-do-peixe.descricao: Fish farm and pay-to-fish pond. A pleasant setting on the banks of the Paraíba do Sul River, where visitors can enjoy a meal.

komeningue-lanchonete-e-pizzaria.descricao: Artisan pizza made with homemade dough and baked on stone.
komeningue-lanchonete-e-pizzaria.funcionamento: Monday, Wednesday, Thursday and Sunday, 3 pm to midnight. Friday and Saturday, 3 pm to 2 am.

ovos-caipira-por-do-sol.descricao: High-quality free-range eggs. A place in the fresh air, with well-cared-for hens living with more freedom.

cachaca-bousquet.descricao: Visit to the facilities, direct contact with nature, export-quality artisanal cachaça.
cachaca-bousquet.funcionamento: Monday to Friday, 8–11:30 am and 1:30–5 pm.

ferjackvale.descricao: Visitors can spend a relaxing day in contact with nature, enjoy a good meal and go fishing in a wonderful lake.

destilaria-vista-alegre.descricao: Production and rooting during the harvest season. Service, artisanal cachaça and sales.
destilaria-vista-alegre.funcionamento: Monday to Friday, 8 am–5 pm. Saturday, 8 am–noon.

bar-do-edesio.descricao: The place offers tourists the chance to swim in a beautiful waterfall, play football on a society (artificial turf) pitch and eat the best freshly made pastel (fried pastry) in the region. It has a large space for hosting events.

parque-natural-municipal-sabia-laranjeir.descricao: Tourism in direct contact with nature, appreciation of local fauna and flora, and trails leading to waterfalls and rapids of the Itabapoana River.
