rio-life-eventos-eirelli.descricao: Direct contact with nature, lunch and sports events. Sustainability and social services.
rio-life-eventos-eirelli.funcionamento: Restaurant: Saturday to Sunday, noon–4 pm; Pub: Friday, 6–10 pm; Saturday, 9 am–9 pm and Sunday, 9 am–5 pm; Lodging: Friday to Sunday, 24 hours.

espaco-show.descricao: Reservoir fishing, a visit to the Pedra do Mutum de Baixo, declared a historical, cultural and tourist heritage site of the municipality, carriage rides, typical dishes (free-range chicken, steam-cooked ribs, etc.), among other things.

pousada-boa-vista.descricao: The place offers direct contact with nature, fresh air and a beautiful landscape, perfect for peace, tranquility and rest. It has a restaurant serving typical dishes cooked on a wood-burning stove, and lodging in chalets. It has lakes with pedal boats, plus a waterfall for a refreshing swim. Perfect fun for the whole family!

pesque-pague-recanto-das-palmeiras.descricao: Fishing, a pleasant family-friendly, tree-shaded place with excellent service.

recanto-beira-rio.descricao: It offers lodging and a restaurant with a delicious buffet, providing much more than a simple lunch: a local gastronomic experience. A perfect place to breathe the fresh country air, overlooking the beautiful Itabapoana River. Nothing beats the peace that nature brings to this place!
recanto-beira-rio.funcionamento: Restaurant: Saturday and Sunday, 9 am–6 pm. Lodging: every day, 24 hours.

pousada-lurdes-dnilo.descricao: It offers cozy lodging, a welcome for guests in an intimate, family atmosphere, and a rural breakfast prepared with ingredients from the farm. Experience tourism with a corral next to the inn, where visitors can get close to the animals.
pousada-lurdes-dnilo.funcionamento: The inn is open every day, but only by appointment.

casa-do-artesao-de-bom-jesus-do-itabapoa.descricao: A place to visit, view exhibitions and buy handmade products. The Casa do Artesão de Bom Jesus do Itabapoana is an income-generating alternative for the municipality, and includes the "Solidarity Economy" program.

aguardente-de-cana-california.descricao: Visitors will learn about the stages of artisanal cachaça production, including milling and aging. They can also see how rapadura is made, another product that also comes from sugarcane.

fazenda-da-penha.descricao: Product tasting. Sustainable production, more flavor, more health on your table! Gastronomy and crafts. Black Ônix gourmet rice and red rice.

sitio-santo-amaro-pesque-e-pague.descricao: Small farm with a pay-to-fish pond, swimming pool and a spacious, tree-shaded kiosk.

casa-do-artesao-de-italva.descricao: Spacious venue with a wide choice of handicraft gifts.

alambique-morro-grande.descricao: Learn how artisanal cachaça is made.

haras-santa-joaquina.descricao: Horse breaking, horses for rides, exotic birds, dairy corral, pony, mini cattle and waterfowl.

alambique-engenho-bau-2.descricao: Follow the artisanal cachaça production process, with sensory analysis and tasting.

queijaria-copafi.descricao: Family-farming cooperative, with visits to the production site and a shop selling regional products.

restaurante-e-pousada-taquari-e-paiol.descricao: Gastronomy, wine cellar, rafting, trails, rural experience, contact with nature and live music.

hotel-fazenda-raposo.descricao: Rural tourism, enjoying the benefits of a hydromineral spa resort, contact with nature and shopping.

fazenda-rapadura.descricao: We are the only farm in the region with artisanal production and a visitor area where you can see the whole process of making cheese, wine, cachaça, artisanal rapadura, brown sugar, yogurt and honey.
fazenda-rapadura.funcionamento: Monday to Friday, 8 am–5 pm. Saturdays and Sundays, 8 am–12:30 pm.

estancia-hidromineral-soledade.descricao: With its springs in the heart of Raposo, the Estância Hidromineral Soledade has stood out over time for the high quality of its waters. Already famous for their healing power, they attract thousands of tourists every year. In addition, the Estância Hidromineral Soledade offers swimming pools with sulfurous and fluoridated waters, without the use of chemicals. Come and enjoy this wonder of nature!
estancia-hidromineral-soledade.funcionamento: Monday to Friday, 7 am–11 am and 1 pm–5 pm. Saturdays and Sundays, 7 am–5 pm.

fontanario-agua-mineral-raposo-e-hotel-f.descricao: A place for leisure and tranquility. Tasting of various types of mineral water with proven medicinal benefits. The waters of Raposo have medicinal and beneficial properties found nowhere else in Brazil, thanks to the richness of mineral rocks in the subsoil and its exclusive geothermal area.

pousada-emmanuel.descricao: Swimming pool, gym, wood-fired sauna, green area, barbecue kiosk, playgrounds, football field and a restaurant surrounded by plenty of greenery.

emporio-rural-miracema.descricao: The space brings together products and crafts by artists, artisans and rural producers in a single central location, easily accessible and with prices in line with today's reality. Visitors also have the chance to discover products made in the municipality, enriching their cultural knowledge. It offers a variety of goods reflecting the cultural and tourist identity of the town, as well as delicious products from the countryside. Among the artisanal rural products available are: coffee, cheese, sausage, cachaça, honey, propolis, liqueurs, fruit in syrup, candied fruit and compotes, and jams in a variety of flavors. Also available are bed, table and bath decor, religious items (images, rosaries, banners and pennants), basketry, and products with personalized Miracema motifs.
emporio-rural-miracema.funcionamento: Monday to Friday, 8 am–5 pm. Saturday, 8 am–12 pm.

estancia-valao-do-barro.descricao: Horseback riding, pedal boats, traditional food cooked on a wood-fired stove, barbecue grill, outdoor shower and walks through forests, mountains and natural lagoons.

casa-do-artesao-2.descricao: Get to know and support local artists, artisans and handmade work in all its variety, with good service, courteous treatment of customers, and an airy, sanitized space that follows pandemic protocols. Goods are affordably priced and come in personalized packaging, ready for gifting.
casa-do-artesao-2.funcionamento: Monday to Friday, 8 am–5 pm. Saturdays, 8 am–12 pm.

cachaca-miracema.descricao: Visit to an artisanal cachaça production, with aging in oak, amburana and Brazil nut barrels, among others, and unlimited tasting. Sugarcane is planted and milled on the same property, which also has several ponds for fishing and a beautiful rural view.

restaurante-reserva-natividade.descricao: Located very close to the Sanctuary of Nossa Senhora de Natividade, this open-air restaurant sits on a cozy small farm that uses produce grown and harvested on site to serve meals and snacks, all in a truly rural setting with room for the whole family.

sitio-do-engenho.descricao: Visit to a property dating from 1834, on the banks of the São Sebastião stream. It is one of the properties that formed the foundation for the creation of the municipality of Natividade. Part of Fazenda do Engenho was turned into a housing development years ago, which gave rise to the Morada do Engenho neighborhood. This visit is a real escape from urban life and offers plenty of contact with nature.

pousada-e-restaurante-sabor-da-terra.descricao: Lodging, breakfast and lunch, with all products grown and harvested on the property itself.

cafeteria-boa-esperanca.descricao: A variety of roasted coffees, specialty coffee, cakes and the house's special banana sweet. Visit and experience the production process of specialty coffees, harvested at 900 meters above sea level. The visit goes from the field to the cup, passing through the machinery, bean sorting and drying, and ending with a delicious tasting. In 2019 the coffee was voted the second best Specialty Coffee in Rio de Janeiro. The site also offers a view of Pico da Bandeira, the highest point in Brazil's Southeast Region, and a pay-to-fish pond, with the possibility of taking part in banana and coffee crop management.

cafe-iranita.descricao: Visit to the production of Café Iranita, 100% Arabica, a family-farming product grown on sustainable plantations at altitudes between 400 and 600 m. The property was founded in 1993 and is named Sítio Iranita, from the combination of the names Irany and Nita, parents of the owner, Olympio Matheus Ribeiro. From 2005, now under the leadership of Ana Regina and Suhail, investment went into coffee quality, from managing the crop to having the coffee ready for sale. Today the property has the right infrastructure to produce an excellent-quality coffee.
cafe-iranita.funcionamento: Monday to Friday, 8 am–5 pm. Saturdays, 8 am–12 pm.

lee-farm-food.descricao: Rural restaurant, tour of the small farm, kids' area, rental for parties and events.

bar-e-petiscaria-recanto-de-padua.descricao: Snack bar, kids' area, rental for parties and events, and local farm products.

sitio-sao-francisco.descricao: The space is meant for rest and quiet, offering a taste of country life. Our house takes us back to memories that are deeply stored and almost forgotten. It invites us to remember our childhood through games, play and adventures. Surrounded by beautiful trees that serve as a stage for the serenades of many species of birds, it leaves us closer to nature and yet very close to the city. We have a veranda that wraps around the whole house, full of inviting hammocks for a little nap after meals. When we think of the saying "Stressed out? Go fishing!", this is the right place! We have a majestic lake, full of life, where we can practice catch-and-release fishing.

casinha-verde-atelier.descricao: Visitors can see up close the making of handmade lamps crafted from recyclable materials such as glass bottles, bicycle rims, reclaimed wood and more. Our products are shipped to every region of the country, since sales are made mainly online.

emporio-fazenda-campo-grande-restaurante.descricao: Healthy eating with rural, heartfelt cooking.

sitio-agua-limpa.descricao: Rural experience with a swimming pool, forested areas, a peaceful setting, contact with nature and easy access.

cachaca-capelo.descricao: Presentation of the stages of the cachaça-making process (milling, fermentation and settling), a copper kettle for making rapadura and cane molasses, a shop selling the products made on site, and a large green area for taking photos. Artisanal cachaça production at the distillery and sale of bottled cachaça.

producao-de-cafe-especial.descricao: Learn about specialty coffee production. Trained, qualified professionals in their roles.

espaco-familiar-titolandia.descricao: Fish farming, planting and milking. A completely original and diverse rural experience.

sitio-da-serra-boa-vista.descricao: Offers a family-friendly rural setting, ideal for horseback rides and micro-tractor rides, with hiking trails as well as motocross in Serra Boa Vista, fishing in the local lake, and a typical Ubá-style morning coffee for all visitors. The place has a unique beauty, inviting for a dip and for admiring a waterfall during the rainy season; interested visitors can watch and/or take part in milking the cow. It is also a standout area in our municipality for protecting springs, sharing natural drinking water with the whole interested population, and it plants trees for environmental protection, its main distinguishing feature being environmental protection and awareness.

pesqueiro-jp.descricao: The place has a simple kitchen. Appetizer platters, lunch, sweets and drinks. A place where contact with nature is essential. Sport fishing, exotic birds, a children's area, a bar and a small restaurant in a family atmosphere. The place is inspiring. Nature, respect, tasty food and cold beer.
pesqueiro-jp.funcionamento: Public holidays, Saturdays and Sundays, 8 am–5 pm.

fazenda-recreio.descricao: Dairy farming experience and a century-old colonial-style house.

fazenda-pinheiro.descricao: Coffee production from Bean to Cup: we show the whole process of planting, post-harvest, soil, tasting and plenty of conversation. We are family farmers and produce specialty coffees in a 100% artisanal way.

fazenda-dende.descricao: Painting and craft classes, horseback riding, visit to the coffee and grape plantations.

adega-dario-bendia.descricao: Run by Dona Conceição Bendia, it is the most rustic cellar among the city's main jabuticaba wine producers, with more than 100 years of tradition. The wine's alcohol content comes only from the fermentation of the fruit, following a family tradition of using no preservatives.

sitio-xodo.descricao: Tasting and purchase of various products made on the small farm.

pesque-pague-sitio-jaqueira.funcionamento: Monday, 12 pm–6 pm. Tuesday, 9 am–6 pm.

sitio-velho-moinho.descricao: Visit the winery and see the production, with whole-juice processing and the making of wines, jams and liqueur, as well as plantations of various fruits such as jabuticaba, orange, pocan (mandarin), starfruit and more.

atelie-da-serra.descricao: Wines, liqueurs, handicrafts of all kinds, sweets, honey and jams. Visit to a small chapel and a calvary. Several pets on site.

cafe-pelegrini.descricao: Visit to the production and preparation of specialty coffees. Café Pelegrini is grown on sustainable plantations by the Pelegrini Menezes Family and won 1st Place at Rio Coffee Nation in 2020.

adega-zanganelli-pegorer-dchalet.descricao: Visit to the storage cellar. Tasting of D'Chalet products.
adega-zanganelli-pegorer-dchalet.funcionamento: Monday to Saturday, 8 am–6 pm. Sunday, 8 am–12 pm.

sitio-raposinha.descricao: Get in touch with nature and with the making of handcrafted products.

pizzaria-la-pizza.descricao: Pizzeria with a stone oven, gourmet pizza and products from Fazenda Dendê (gourmet, traditional and specialty coffees (ground and beans), stone-ground flour from a water mill, honey, jam, dry jabuticaba wine and rosé wine made from Niágara Rosada grapes.
pizzaria-la-pizza.funcionamento: Thursday to Sunday and on public holidays.

sitio-vai-e-volta-cafes-especiais.descricao: Coffee grown in the northwest of the state of Rio de Janeiro, where a high-altitude tropical climate combined with the careful post-harvest handling of family farmers favors the production of specialty beans. From seed to cup! Visitors will get to know the family production of specialty coffees, grown and roasted by the Rodolphi family, who take care of every detail of production to ensure that the coffee reaches the cup with the quality the plant produced. Two-time champion producer of the first specialty coffee competition of the Northwest Fluminense region.
sitio-vai-e-volta-cafes-especiais.funcionamento: Monday to Friday, 8 am–5 pm, and Saturdays, 9 am–12 pm.

adega-alexandrino-bendia.descricao: Property visits, tastings and sale of craft beer, jabuticaba wine and a variety of liqueurs.

pousada-chacara-vista-alegre.descricao: Although it is considered a rural area, the pousada is a 5-minute drive from the center of Varre-Sai. You can also go on foot. Guests have the privilege of being in the countryside and yet within Varre-Sai, and can even visit a beautiful lavender plantation
